emcee.definition: v. act as a master of ceremonies
emcee.translation:
n. 司仪, 主持人
vt. 担任...主持人, 主持

emceed.definition: v act as a master of ceremonies
emceed.translation: v. 担任…的主持人, 主持( emcee的过去式和过去分词 )

emceeing.definition: v act as a master of ceremonies
emceeing.translation: v. 担任…的主持人, 主持( emcee的现在分词 )

emcees.definition:
n a person who acts as host at formal occasions (makes an introductory speech and introduces other speakers)
v act as a master of ceremonies
emcees.translation:
n. 司仪, 主持人( emcee的名词复数 )
v. 担任…的主持人, 主持( emcee的第三人称单数 )
